tickets.name: The Opener
tickets.note: Thunder at Cavaliers, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! It starts with Allen against Hartenstein at center court, and our money says Allen gets up there first! That puts the Cavaliers on the front foot to get on the board first. And if the Thunder flip the script, Hartenstein is waiting right there to pounce! Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Hartenstein. Let's go!

tickets.name: Tip Drill
tickets.note: Hawks roll into Pacers territory, and the first minute is all we care about! Okongwu and Huff meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! Tip it, run it, finish it. If Okongwu gets that jump, that's the whole plan! Okongwu stands alone in this one, and that's plenty!

tickets.name: First Points
tickets.note: Lights up for Nets at Knicks, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! The jump ball goes Towns against Sharpe, and Towns has the springs tonight! Win that tip and the Knicks are first in line to score. The Nets get a stop? Then it's Sharpe running the other way for the first two! Traore is lurking on the weak side for the kick-out! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!
